_about: The stadium video-board motion set, in game order. The case study (chapter 07) and the deck's "Game day, on the big board" slide both read this list. Each piece has a 1080p loop at public/videos/stadium/<file>.mp4 and its hold frame at public/images/lrhs-stadium/<file>.jpg, cut from the 8K renders (scripts/render-stadium-motion.mjs).

pieces.name: Welcome to The Ranch
pieces.when: Gates open. The first thing on the board.

pieces.name: Touchdown
pieces.when: Full-frame Spirit Red, straight after a Mustangs score.

pieces.name: It’s Good
pieces.when: Field goal or extra point, between the uprights.

pieces.name: First Down
pieces.when: The chains move; the Mustang rides the line.

pieces.name: Make Some Noise
pieces.when: Defence on the field. The meter fills as the type grows.

pieces.name: Turnover
pieces.when: Interception or fumble — the card literally turns over.

pieces.name: Sack
pieces.when: A hard impact frame, then the claws tear through the word.

pieces.name: Starting Lineup
pieces.when: A template: one video per player, from a list of names.

pieces.name: Halftime
pieces.when: Slower and warmer, as the Mustang Band takes the field.

pieces.name: Go Mustangs
pieces.when: The closer for every other night.
